# Deckard 1.11.1 - switch every Site Compare page on or off at once

A small addition to the **On** column that arrived in 1.11.0, in **Site Compare**.

## What is new

- **Switch many pages at once.** The **On** column now has a box in its header: click it to switch every page off, click it again to switch every page on. It is ticked when every page is on, and filled in when only some are. Right-click a page for **Enable all pages** and **Disable all pages**, and for **Disable the other pages**, which leaves only that page on so you can focus a run on it. The box and the menu items are locked while a run is going, like the rest of the list.
- **Teams announcement.** When a new version is released, a message is posted to a Teams chat to say it is available. It is only sent once the release has succeeded.
- **Data Compare command line fix.** `Deckard.exe data` could, now and then, print "Compared 0 table(s)" and report no differences for databases that do differ, because it read its table counts before they had all been recorded. The counts are now complete before the summary is printed.
